**MicnKey Deck v1.3.1** – fix: MIC could open Claude's live voice mode.

- v1.3 added "Use voice mode" to the fast list of mic-button names. In the Claude app that button starts a live voice conversation, not dictation, so MIC could open voice mode instead of typing your words into the chat box.
- MIC now never presses buttons named like "voice mode", "voice chat" or "talk to" – only real dictation buttons (Dictate, Start dictation, Stop/Finish dictation).

### Install / update
1. Download **MicnKey-Deck-v1.3.1.zip** below.
2. Right-click the zip → **Properties** → tick **Unblock** → OK → **Extract All**.
3. Double-click **Install.cmd**. Updating keeps your keys and settings.
